notes.title: 2023 Review / 2024 Preview
notes.content:
[h2]Looking Back At 2023[/h2]

Earlier in the year, our demo for [i]The BridgeMaster[/i] was released on Steam, coinciding with its feature in the [b]Steam Puzzle Fest[/b]! This got a lot more eyes on the game and produced more of your valuable feedback (more on that below).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/f0aecc811dd22e53531612c0aeb41865bf662a89.jpg[/img]

Then we were pleasantly surprised and very honored to be selected for the [b][url=https://six.seattleindies.org]Seattle Indies Expo[/url][/b]! We were among 25 games in the showcase, chosen from more than 50 that applied, so we feel very grateful indeed. Be sure to check out SIX's [b][url=https://www.geekwire.com/2023/a-list-of-20-interesting-and-weird-indie-games-developed-in-the-pacific-northwest]other games[/url][/b] too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/066f7e3a52c1ed63f21ecbee2e0c71da168ff631.png[/img]

About a month later, we were back for the [b]SIX Online[/b] portion of the expo to share the game in an interview on Twitch! ICYMI, here's the video:

[url=https://youtu.be/MnpnOvCCUts?t=23921][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/fd421515e59eb068be144ab19b2ec419481fdd2d.png[/img][/url]
[i](click to view at the timestamp where our segment begins)[/i]

The builds for both of these events were preceded by plenty of playtesting and polishing. We made many enhancements, including:

[list]
[*] Adding the much requested option to "Undo" per action
[*] Adding the scroll collectibles advancing the plot
[*] Expanding the intro to help establish the premise
[*] Introducing tutorial prompts to help onboard new players
[*] Lots of improvements with VFX, SFX, and bug-fixing
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/c2f2a06fd6b21fe00b4c9880bc7cf784bca17f37.png[/img]

Check out our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1375140]previous posts[/url][/b] to see more details on these events and all the various changes.

[h2]Looking Ahead To 2024[/h2]

With all that's occurred in 2023, we feel set up for success in 2024! 🎉

Now that we've got a reasonably polished demo as a "vertical slice" of the game, we're building a "[b][url=https://x.com/CrimsonStoneDev/status/1736158499451945145]horizontal slice[/url][/b]" that spans the full game's breadth of content. Once complete, we can avoid the risks of otherwise premature polish efforts being invalidated by major content iteration. That looks like so:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/bd318f7961b5a905ff6eb202cff3586c38911f2b.gif[/img]

In the near term, this means we're primarily prototyping our next puzzle mechanics. We'll then utilize these to design, test, and iterate on the remainder of the level progression. We've already made some headway on that effort, which you can see a sneak peek of here:

[previewyoutube=E98OR9Fhkoc;full][/previewyoutube]

Before long, we'll have several new levels utilizing these mechanics and more. Remember I mentioned your valuable feedback? Later in 2024, we will be seeking folks for playtesting to help us make a greater game. If you'd like to contribute, be sure to follow us both here and on Twitter ([b][url=https://twitter.com/CrimsonStoneDev]@CrimsonStoneDev[/url][/b]) to find out how you can join us when the time comes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/ab2bd22f3e128ebb747ddaf8cb7bd4bef2c7f584.png[/img]

[h3]Thanks for all your support so far, and we're excited for all that we have planned in 2024![/h3]

notes.title: Selected for the SIX Expo!
notes.content:
[h2]SIX 2023[/h2]

We are very thrilled to share that we’ve been selected for the 2023 lineup of the [url=https://six.seattleindies.org]Seattle Indies Expo[/url]! This weekend, we’ll be exhibiting [i]The BridgeMaster[/i] at the Motif in Seattle for this [b]free[/b] event on Sunday, September 3rd, from noon to 9pm. It’s just a [url=https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Washington+State+Convention+Center,+Pike+Street,+Seattle,+WA/Motif+Seattle,+1415+5th+Ave,+Seattle,+WA+98101/@47.6105811,-122.3357848,17.5z/am=t/data=!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x54906ab5090f3cc7:0x38d32c762126bc69!2m2!1d-122.3314234!2d47.6118106!1m5!1m1!1s0x54906ab47e66b98d:0xace4826f81880ed!2m2!1d-122.3355909!2d47.610082!3e2?entry=ttu]short walk[/url] from the Seattle Convention Center if you happen to be there for PAX. We’d love to see you there!

We’re definitely feeling very grateful to be selected! This year, 57 games applied to be part of the showcase, and after 300+ reviews conducted by the panel of jurors, less than half (25) were ultimately selected to be part of the official [url=https://six.seattleindies.org/]SIX lineup[/url]. We feel very much in good company with an impressive variety of unique indie games, all made here in the Pacific Northwest. We encourage you to check out the other games in the lineup as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/066f7e3a52c1ed63f21ecbee2e0c71da168ff631.png[/img]

[h2]Recent Demo Updates[/h2]

To prepare for our SIX submission, we made many updates to the demo after the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1375140/view/3696937896974452692?l=english]Steam Puzzle Fest[/url]. Throughout the process, we conducted playtests regularly to keep a close eye on what was working and what was not. There’s always more room for improvement of course, but we’re confident in saying that the game is now in its best state so far!

[h2]Here are many of the changes we’ve made recently:[/h2]

[h3]Design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Expand intro with new illustrated story panels
[*] Add to, clarify, and rearrange dialogue
[*] Remove input suppression with bridge tremble
[*] Implement support for continuous keyboard input
[*] Raise star thresholds to reward perfect play
[*] Update villager AI to walk instead of jump if possible
[*] Make villager spawns static per level
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/c2f2a06fd6b21fe00b4c9880bc7cf784bca17f37.png[/img]

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add VFX for rickety bridge tremble
[*] Update jump rune icon for legibility
[*] Display yellow pips for jump segments of escape paths
[*] Add environmental props to title screen and Worlds 2 & 3
[*] Include adjacent props when destroying houses
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/f92d8d7cd538b20f0a90e6190d4f43f65257c01a.png[/img]

[h3]UI / UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add Level Select menu to in-game HUD
[*] Lerp wood icons to resource counter
[*] Disable Undo & Restart when moves = 0
[*] Add pagination buttons and X/Y counter to hints
[*] Clear FTUE prompts upon activating hint
[*] Lerp text scale on updates to move and hint counts
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/afc4d5a8237e8a453a3422c769378cb21edd0a13.png[/img]

[h3]First Time User Experience (FTUE)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add to and improve hints for all levels
[*] Hide hints after the magician moves
[*] Add FTUE prompt about how villagers escape in Level 2
[*] Add FTUE prompts for (de)construction in Level 3
[*] Add FTUE prompt for Undo/Restart in Levels 4 & 5
[*] Add FTUE prompt for jump runes in Level 10
[*] Add FTUE prompt for rickety bridge in Level 16
[*] Clear FTUE prompt for Undo/Restart once either is used
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/52bc5ded1a88ccd2e936bc532422cdf1e561eb6e.png[/img]

[h3]Music & SFX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replace ground rumble and add tile collapse SFX for intro
[*] Update footsteps SFX per character and surface type
[*] Add SFX for scroll pickup, rickety bridge, undo, and tile debris
[*] Add pencil scribble SFX for scroll dialogue and hints
[*] Play SFX at reduced volume in title screen
[*] Lerp in/out of paused low pass filter on music
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/a3db30168cca82f338dd16b89f515129e40b7ca9.png[/img]

[h3]Optimization & Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Limit frame rate to monitor refresh rate
[*] Self-destruct dust and splinter VFX
[*] Bugfixes for rickety bridges after undo
[*] Bugfixes for duplicated actions
[*] Bugfix for Level Summary scrim
[*] Bugfix for lerping wood icons
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/f39635a88b514417562b315565909361e78fb9c0.png[/img]

[h3]As always, thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more to come![/h3]

notes.title: Summer '23 Devlog
notes.content:
[h2]Hello friends & followers![/h2]

This past month, we’ve had more happening with The BridgeMaster than we’ve had in a while! The game came out with an updated demo featured in the Steam Puzzle Fest, which got many new eyes on the game. And since then, we’ve made further updates to the demo, which you can now experience in the latest version today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/f0aecc811dd22e53531612c0aeb41865bf662a89.jpg[/img]

[h2]Here are some of the changes we’ve made recently:[/h2]

[h3]Design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the much requested “Undo” per action option!
[*] Added scroll collectibles to some levels with dialogue advancing the plot
[*] Updated dialogue for Intro sequence to clarify premise
[*] Display differing villager responses depending on game state in levels 2 & 4
[*] Added FTUE prompts for using the “Undo” “Restart” and “Hint” options
[*] Raised the 3-star thresholds to reward strictly perfect solutions
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/3fa60d7f4269ffb0e2e2a1437ca2a636e3e24116.png[/img]

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Show land tiles collapsing during the Intro sequence
[*] Replaced jump tile rune with omni-directional icon for clarity
[*] Updated meshes for tile nodes to appear more naturally shaped
[*] Pause time scale while using the “Home” menu
[*] Added VFX of debris periodically falling from tiles
[*] Added VFX of dust cloud and planks falling from rickety bridges
[*] Added VFX of magic sparkles over jump rune tiles
[*] Improved VFX for house deconstruction effect
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/9ca0d1034a7846a404a5cc4f5a0f3f178679e456.png[/img]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added SFX for ground rumble during Intro
[*] Added SFX for footsteps for magician and villagers
[*] Added SFX for puzzle solved on level completion
[*] Added SFX for UI button interactions
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/5717152192d13dbb68c09d8e3044eb336e48f408.png[/img]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a scaling issue for logo text in 4K resolutions
[*] Fixed position of some UI elements for non-16:9 aspect ratios
[*] Fixed sliding / frozen animations for villagers escaping
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/ab2bd22f3e128ebb747ddaf8cb7bd4bef2c7f584.png[/img]

[h3]As always, thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more to come![/h3]
